cast.name: Ethan Thorne
cast.desc: Aerokinesis: control of air, wind and pressure, fought through techniques like Windstep, Gale Guard, Pressure Break and Sky Rend. Wind Guardian mode manifests for the first time in the final fight against Isaac. In Season 1 he never used wind as a weapon: he saw it as a friend. From Season 5 he runs both engines at once, polite and savage together.

cast.name: Elizah
cast.desc: Hemokinesis: complete control of blood as fuel, weapon, armor and memory, including Sanguine Shift (moving through his own blood) and blood constructs. Ethan’s alter ego, built in a lonely, bullied childhood. For a time he lived in a clone of Ethan’s body, which he kept alive by pushing blood through it himself. His blueprint always lives inside Ethan.

cast.name: Zayn Hayes
cast.desc: Astrapo-Electrokinesis: electricity, lightning and thunder. Red lightning (Crimson Astrapo), inherited from Dorian, as his execution mode.

cast.name: Xinea
cast.desc: Aether Dominion: control of the layer between matter and soul. Phasing, soul-touch and void erasure. Her early healing and fire were leaks of Aether.

cast.name: Valeria
cast.desc: Peak human assassin: Shadow Step, silent movement and the finest sword in the SCU. An incorruptible mind. Later wields Kara Yazgı.

cast.name: Nilanjona
cast.desc: Hydrokinesis: water’s flow, pressure and state. Stronger near water and with a calm mind. Accepts the Water Guardian’s path.

cast.name: Grace
cast.desc: Divine Healing (Aegis of Mercy) and Athena’s Judgement, the Golden Eye: a court that weighs absolute moral weight. Holder of the light core.

cast.name: Weston Hale
cast.desc: White Lightning Drive: kinetic speed that stacks momentum and exists only while he moves.

cast.name: Damian Brown
cast.desc: Strategy and Aldercrest spellcasting.

cast.name: Rowan Colloway
cast.desc: Red Flame Fist and super strength, then the Duskmoor flame, then earth.

cast.name: Ayaan Siddique
cast.desc: Tech genius and tech support. His mind is his weapon, the seed of Echogrim.

cast.name: Samuel Sterling
cast.desc: Peak-human super-soldier with no powers: Ghost Sense awareness, extreme endurance, a hardened tie as a weapon, and anything else as a weapon.

cast.name: David (Dawood)
cast.desc: Psychokinetic dagger mastery through the Call of Sharpness. Opens short-range portals with his daggers.

cast.name: Maliha
cast.desc: Healing and hand-to-hand combat.

cast.name: Nur
cast.desc: Blood Magic that fuels, summons, binds and extends life, which he refuses to use. Carries Iqaris’s soul essence.

cast.name: Aariz Maddox
cast.desc: Bestiakinesis and hyperkinesis: speaks with and becomes animals, with heightened senses. Gains a mythical beast’s power after defeating it.

cast.name: Saya
cast.desc: Long-range weapons specialist raised in DEW. Valeria’s heir in skill, later holder of Kara Yazgı and heir to Anna’s sword.

cast.name: Nytheris
cast.desc: The Nature Guardian, present across eras.

cast.name: Amaya
cast.desc: Acidic poison in mist, streams and vapor. The only winged character in the SCU.

cast.name: Yoshiko Arashi
cast.desc: Chaos and Order (Forward and Break commands), Shishōjutsu corpse control through ofuda, and a full weapon set.

cast.name: Derek Miles
cast.desc: The first Ichor subject: human strength and speed at full output, faster recovery, and the Vanguard Pistol.

cast.name: Dorian Cross
cast.desc: Red lightning, the last carrier of it, which disrupts blood art. Elite battle IQ.

cast.name: Eldrich Aldercrest
cast.desc: Aldercrest magic. Cursed by Khalid. Stole the Architect Cube back from Agnus and gave it to Zaan.

cast.name: Norman
cast.desc: Cursed vampire: strength, speed, regeneration, predator senses, partial shapeshifting and mass nightmare control.

cast.name: Agnus El-Mansur
cast.desc: Qahr al-Wujud, making existence obey his will, and the Call of Sharpness, blades as authority. Guarded the Architect Cube for a long time.

cast.name: Silas Duskmoor
cast.codename: Seraph of the Ash, Dragon Slayer
cast.desc: The Blue Flame, which burns only corrupted souls. Explosive, full-commitment fighting.

cast.name: Marcello Corvani
cast.desc: No powers: stubbornness, leadership and mercy. Founded Redline’s team.

cast.name: Kensho Arashi
cast.desc: Blind swordsmanship that keeps improving. Taught Valeria’s sword philosophy and trained Mashiho.

cast.name: Anna
cast.desc: Peak human. Faced super beings without fear and won. Her ancestral sword passes through chosen heirs.

cast.name: Issabela
cast.desc: Led the Nullborn Rome cell; later a detached assassin.

cast.name: Anthony
cast.desc: Rebuilt the Nullborn. His preserved essence was placed inside Derek Miles.

cast.name: Joe Rainer
cast.desc: Not recorded in the files.

cast.name: William Victor
cast.desc: Scientist and HWKS veteran. Co-founded ECAP; his formula is the base of the A-IV serum.

cast.name: Stitch
cast.desc: HWKS veteran and strategist who co-founded ECAP and turned the Old Order into DEW. Alt David’s partner in name only: each used the other, and each knew the other might end him.

cast.name: Kazumi
cast.desc: Trained by elite killers inside the Kurohana.

cast.name: Ramiz Al-Ahd
cast.desc: Nullborn spy and Architect Cube guardian. Father of Anna and Issabela.

cast.name: Soa Aldercrest
cast.desc: Held Athena’s Judgement before Grace.

cast.name: Elina Quins
cast.desc: Eldrich’s love. No powers recorded.

cast.name: Pristine
cast.bloodline: Demon Clan and Dragonic (Khalid and Freya)
cast.desc: Prismorph: real-time adaptive shapeshifting, speed over force. Twin Ascension when both bloodlines awaken.

cast.name: Arzuna
cast.desc: Unique vampiric hybrid with Blood Resonance, inheriting echoes of bonded people’s gifts. Azure Revenant State.

cast.name: Arthur
cast.desc: Pure dragon physiology: monstrous strength, dragon-scale durability and fast regeneration.

cast.name: Gabriel
cast.desc: Dragon.

cast.name: Freya
cast.desc: Dragon, once a near-undefeated hero of the beast realm.

cast.name: Niharo
cast.desc: Omni-Ergon: absorbs, stores, converts and releases any energy, as the vessel of all elements.

cast.name: Alt Ethan
cast.desc: The alternate Ethan, the most moral man turned threat.

cast.name: Alt Rowan
cast.desc: The alternate Rowan, killed by Rowan and Samuel.

cast.name: Alt Weston
cast.desc: The alternate Weston, a Covenant prisoner who dies of extreme aging.

cast.name: Alt Zayn
cast.desc: The alternate Zayn, manipulated by Asetra.

cast.name: Alt Xinea
cast.desc: The alternate Xinea.

cast.name: Alt David
cast.desc: Architect of the Covenant, using Ethereal Splicing and the Aether siphon stone. He wants the Architect Cube to rewrite everyone’s memories into his own world’s versions.

cast.name: Evan Grant
cast.desc: Not recorded in the files.

cast.name: Tedmond Duskmoor
cast.desc: The Blue Flame and raw skill. Spirit and dragon blood let him outlive normal humans.

cast.name: Mashiho Kurohana
cast.desc: Trained in exile by Arashi. Learns Kara curse-binding.

cast.name: Khalid
cast.desc: Abyssal Blood Dominion, living, corrupting blood, and Umbrakinesis, demonic shadow control.

cast.name: Asetra
cast.desc: Atomokinesis, omniscience, oneirokinesis and psychological dominion. The most powerful being in the SCU.

cast.name: Isaac Ezekiel
cast.desc: Genius intellect, technology and magic learned through sleep time jumps. Opens the void and jumps through time.

cast.name: Isaac’s father
cast.desc: Weakened the realm seals.

cast.name: Isaac’s mother
cast.desc: Never taught her son witchcraft. Sold her soul to Mephisto to preserve his body.

cast.name: Mira
cast.desc: Isaac’s love in the HWKS era.

cast.name: Mephisto
cast.desc: Contracts. He never lies, only chooses which truths to tell.

cast.name: Diablo
cast.desc: Led the Diablo Wars.

cast.name: Malachar
cast.desc: Strategy and calculation.

cast.name: Iqaris
cast.desc: Witch arts, one of the few demons to master them.

cast.name: Zaan al-Murad
cast.desc: Revival science, blood regeneration, berserk strength and speed. Eldrich entrusted the Architect Cube to him.

cast.name: Shina Nasrin
cast.desc: Zaan’s love.

cast.name: Ayesha Khatoon
cast.desc: Sheltered Zaan and Shina.

cast.name: Raisa bint Khalid
cast.desc: Time-based revival research.

cast.name: Rahim Ibn Suleiman
cast.desc: Raisa’s husband.

cast.name: Mara Duskmoor
cast.desc: Separates corruption from a person and burns only the corruption.

cast.name: Aeric Valenheart
cast.desc: Cursed weapon crafting. Forged Kara Yazgı.

cast.name: Kael Agharri
cast.desc: One of his bloodline’s most powerful warriors. Raised Niharo.

cast.name: Seren Kara
cast.desc: Binds protective curses into buildings and objects.

cast.name: Francisco
cast.desc: Nullborn operative, Khalid’s father.

cast.name: Mateo Cruz
cast.desc: Regeneration through cancer fused with Ichor. His body learns from every death.

cast.name: Alistair Quinn
cast.desc: Genius strategist bound by a Mephisto smile clause.

cast.name: Eveline
cast.desc: Alistair’s sister.

cast.name: Raya
cast.desc: Alistair’s love.

cast.name: Arvin
cast.desc: Peak human: para-commando, NSI training and master-level strategy.

cast.name: Sean Stone
cast.desc: Peak human. HWKS founder and the most dangerous man of his era.

cast.name: Adrian Kessler
cast.desc: Peak human. Son of a corrupt chairperson; the man Stitch could never catch.

cast.name: Maverick #3
cast.desc: Young, voiceless peak human who speaks through a device.

cast.name: Jada
cast.desc: Not recorded in the files.

cast.name: Pride
cast.desc: Eldest and strongest of the seven siblings.

cast.name: Greed
cast.desc: Raised Kazumi on lies.

cast.name: Lust
cast.desc: Defeated by Arashi.

cast.name: Sloth
cast.desc: Not recorded in the files.

cast.name: Envy
cast.desc: Not recorded in the files.

cast.name: Gluttony
cast.desc: Not recorded in the files.

cast.name: Kaizen
cast.desc: Not recorded yet.

cast.name: Isagi
cast.desc: Not recorded yet.

cast.name: Azwar
cast.desc: Not recorded yet.

cast.name: Azwain
cast.desc: Not recorded yet.

cast.name: The Beast King
cast.desc: Not recorded yet.

cast.name: Orion
cast.desc: Not recorded yet.

cast.name: Saya (Divine Beasts)
cast.desc: Not recorded yet.

cast.name: Maya
cast.desc: Not recorded yet.

cast.name: Graye
cast.desc: Not recorded yet.

cast.name: Ayesha (Khalid’s mother)
cast.desc: Killed by her son in 1461 for the pendant fragment.

cast.name: Marco
cast.desc: Core member of the Nullborn Rome cell. Killed by Khalid in 1461.

cast.name: Mehnaz
cast.desc: Core member of the Nullborn Rome cell. Did not survive its collapse.

cast.name: Abdul
cast.desc: Core member of the Nullborn Rome cell. Did not survive its collapse.

cast.name: Hassan
cast.desc: A Nullborn keeper of knowledge about the seal, who chose death rather than give it to Khalid.

cast.name: Piedro
cast.desc: A beggar turned renegade who stole Anna’s sword and was corrupted by it. Killed by Khalid.

cast.name: The Borgia (Rodrigo and Cesare)
cast.desc: Took control of the Nullborn through a puppet leader until Anthony rebuilt it.

cast.name: Steven Aldercrest
cast.desc: Eldrich’s father and a Cube guardian, who passed the Architect Cube to Dorian: “Destiny needs rebellion, not perfection.”

cast.name: Abbas
cast.desc: One-legged leader of the Forgotten Ones who betrayed Zaan’s location for gold.

cast.name: Dirham
cast.desc: Half-blind leader of the Forgotten Ones.

cast.name: Hisam
cast.desc: A lonely village boy Zaan befriended with his last piece of bread.

cast.name: Mizan
cast.desc: A young villager who admired Zaan, who meant to buy him new shoes.

cast.name: Raijan
cast.desc: A young villager who admired Zaan.

cast.name: Shahdat
cast.desc: A young villager who admired Zaan.

cast.name: Rahmat
cast.desc: A young villager who admired Zaan.

cast.name: Arashi’s wife
cast.desc: Assaulted by Lust and threatened into silence by the brothers; mother of Yoshiko and Kazumi.

cast.name: The former Wind Guardian
cast.desc: An arrogant Wind Guardian whom Ethan defeated at Yasnaya, the place Ethan was meant to rule.

cast.name: The Water Guardian
cast.desc: The guardian destined to mentor Nilanjona.

cast.name: The Sky Guardian
cast.desc: Destroyed in Season 5 by the integrated Ethan and Elizah.

cast.name: Lucen Vale
cast.desc: Product of DEW’s Velocity Genome Program, tied to Alt Weston’s cloning.

cast.name: Riven Creed
cast.desc: Wears DEW’s Silent Node exosuit.

cast.name: Midory
cast.desc: A later member of the Redline team. Little else is recorded.

cast.name: The HWKS vice captain
cast.desc: Sean’s closest friend, bought by the network. Arranged Sean’s murder; executed by Maverick #2.

cast.name: Adrian’s father
cast.desc: A corrupt chairperson behind HWKS who sacrificed his favorite son.

cast.name: The third leader
cast.desc: The seven families leader Corvani spared because of the child in his car, who later killed him.

cast.name: Corvani’s wife
cast.desc: Secretly guarded by Redline and Valeria after his death.

cast.name: Corvani’s son
cast.desc: A primary-school boy, secretly guarded by Redline and Valeria after his father’s death.

cast.name: Kaelor Ashvane
cast.desc: Neurotoxic venom that paralyzes rather than destroys. He telegraphs every strike with a glowing hood-pulse around his arm: the warning means negotiation is over. The last ambassador to the Dragon Court.

cast.name: Velmora Ishtaan
cast.desc: Dual neurotoxic and cytotoxic venom, but she almost never fights. Her intelligence network, the Watching Eye, dismantles threats before they arrive. The Beast Realm’s de facto highest civil authority.

cast.name: Ophirion Drakhar
cast.desc: A towering apex snake-eater with a venom payload that could kill an elephant, who fights at full height. Offered the crown because the houses couldn’t safely oppose him.

cast.name: Sethan Vael
cast.desc: Passive until he switches, then controlled neurotoxic sequences that disable motor functions in order. A Dragon Order-trained judge whose own law was exploited to destroy Hollowreed.

cast.name: Viresh Kothar
cast.desc: Venom no one can predict a treatment for, and preparation so thorough the fight is the last step. The first to document the Viper Covenant, now working outside the system.

cast.name: Sulhan Nightveil
cast.desc: A painless, progressively paralyzing venom. A former healer of the krait medical order who could make dying feel like release.

cast.name: Ravek Stillfang
cast.desc: Hemotoxic venom that turns the victim’s own blood against them, a figure-eight striking stance, and a viper’s heat sense that reads what every being desires.

groups.name: Aether Dominion
groups.desc: Control of the layer between matter and soul. The strongest ability in the SCU. Overuse brings numbness and detachment from reality.

groups.name: Force Field
groups.desc: The suppressed form of her power while the siphon stone drained her. Shields in many shapes.

groups.name: Early Leaks
groups.desc: Aether leaking under trauma before she understood it. To the world it looked like fire and healing.

groups.name: Athena’s Judgement
groups.desc: The Golden Eye: it judges absolute moral weight, not the story anyone tells. It costs its bearer empathy, sleep and identity.

groups.name: Aegis of Mercy
groups.desc: Divine healing for physical trauma, cellular collapse and limited spiritual fractures, at a heavy mental cost.

groups.name: Light Core
groups.desc: The sun-side core. It reveals, judges and burns what hides.

groups.name: Dark Core
groups.desc: The moon-side core: quiet, protective darkness that hides and balances. Its godly expression is Aether.

groups.name: Balance Host
groups.desc: The seat held first by Asetra, then Xinea. A host keeps the cosmic scales, and must not take sides.

groups.name: Temporal Drift
groups.desc: Involuntary jumps through time that happen while he sleeps. He never learned why.

groups.name: Time Perception Magic
groups.desc: Slows the caster’s awareness, not time itself.

groups.name: Qahr al-Wujud
groups.desc: Command over existence: reality treats his will as the highest priority. Blunt authority with no fine control.

groups.name: Call of Sharpness: Authority
groups.desc: Blades as judges: floating formations that wait in rigid symmetry for a verdict.

groups.name: Susume (Forward)
groups.desc: An Order command that improves technique efficiency and cuts wasted energy, on herself, allies or controlled units.

groups.name: Call of Sharpness: Chaos
groups.desc: Blades born from a mind that rejects hesitation: swarming, unpredictable and enjoying itself.

groups.name: Chaos Mind
groups.desc: His power grows with madness and enjoyment, and turns cleaner but weaker when he is calm.

groups.name: Kuzuse (Break)
groups.desc: A Chaos command that injects instability into a target’s rhythm. Deadliest against overconfident fighters and mid-cast mages.

groups.name: Oneirokinesis
groups.desc: Dream dominion: she enters dreams while awake and kills the will without touching the body.

groups.name: Psychological Dominion
groups.desc: Her cruelest power: she amplifies the fear, guilt or desire already inside you. It works on any species.

groups.name: Omniscience
groups.desc: She sees every possible future, not just one. Surprise does not work on her.

groups.name: Nightmare Dominion
groups.desc: Fear-based hallucinations: victims see themselves failing, not monsters.

groups.name: Nightmare Induction
groups.desc: Selective fear and regret projected through eye contact.

groups.name: Memory Manipulation
groups.desc: Claw-triggered: implant false memories, extract trauma or twist events. Used sparingly.

groups.name: Dagger Portals
groups.desc: Short-range spatial tears opened by thrown daggers.

groups.name: Cross-Dimensional Spatial Access
groups.desc: An unstable evolution under the Cube’s influence: portals reach beyond local space.

groups.name: Dimensional Run
groups.desc: Speed beyond physical space that skims dimensions and distorts time. Every use ages him.

groups.name: Dimension Magic
groups.desc: Rift, fold and anchor magic.

groups.name: Voidcall
groups.desc: His void first opened by instinct to survive Tedmond. It sends people out of reach.

groups.name: Curse Techniques
groups.desc: Curses are intent made permanent. His are planted through blood and spread through bloodlines.

groups.name: Pyrokinesis
groups.desc: Fire as an element: heat, fire and combustion under the user’s will. Niharo carries it beside his flame.

groups.name: Rowan’s Flame
groups.desc: His base fire: flame as punches, bursts and grabs.

groups.name: Red Flame Magic
groups.desc: Rage-fed arcane combustion, not elemental fire. Power spikes violently and the body strains.

groups.name: Duskmoor Flame
groups.desc: The Blue Flame. It is not elemental fire: it burns souls, curses and corruption, and only corrupted souls. It erases instead of exploding.

groups.name: Corruption Separation
groups.desc: She never received the flame. She separates corruption from a person and burns only that, if they truly want to be free.

groups.name: Molten Flame
groups.desc: Flame born of lava, rage and dragon heat, not the element itself. Niharo carries it alongside his fire.

groups.name: Hydrokinesis
groups.desc: Controls water’s flow, pressure and state wherever water exists. Stronger near water and with a calm mind.

groups.name: Hydro Regeneration
groups.desc: Water accelerates healing, cleans wounds and gradually restores stamina.

groups.name: Cryokinesis
groups.desc: Unlocked as the Water Guardian: instant freezing, ice armor and permanent ice.

groups.name: Tide
groups.desc: The moon’s pull on water.

groups.name: Earth Awakening
groups.desc: Rowan’s second awakening: earth reinforces his body and reshapes the battlefield.

groups.name: Atomokinesis
groups.desc: Control of atoms: reshape, disintegrate and rebuild matter.

groups.name: Aerokinesis
groups.desc: Control of air, wind and pressure. The wind responds to calm and spikes with emotion.

groups.name: Wind Guardian Mode
groups.desc: Manifests for the first time in the final fight against Isaac.

groups.name: Wind and Blood Hybrids
groups.desc: Combination executions that merge his wind with Elizah’s blood, not new abilities.

groups.name: Weather Influence
groups.desc: Localized, controlled weather.

groups.name: Astrapo-Electrokinesis
groups.desc: Control of the whole electrical phenomenon: charge, discharge, sound and motion.

groups.name: Red Lightning
groups.desc: The bloodline’s overcharged lightning: faster than normal lightning, unstable, harder to absorb or redirect. It disrupts blood art. Dorian’s origin.

groups.name: Crimson Astrapo
groups.desc: Zayn’s refined prime ability, built on red lightning. Similar, but not the same thing.

groups.name: White Lightning Drive
groups.desc: Not elemental: bio-electric kinetic speed that stacks momentum. It exists only while he moves.

groups.name: Divine Constructs
groups.desc: Golden weapons, barriers and sigils.

groups.name: Sanctified Mobility
groups.desc: Short-range divine movement, like light folding.

groups.name: Umbrakinesis
groups.desc: Demonic control of darkness: animate shadows, absorb light and become darkness.

groups.name: Revenant Shadow
groups.desc: Shadow-fluid manipulation tied to her emotional bonds.

groups.name: Dark Arcana
groups.desc: Bound shadow: seals and suppression fields.

groups.name: Concealment Magic
groups.desc: Invisibility and presence erasure.

groups.name: Restoration
groups.desc: General healing paired with close combat.

groups.name: Nature Dominion
groups.desc: The Nature Guardian’s command over plants and living nature.

groups.name: Bestiakinesis
groups.desc: Communicate with animals, control their instincts and transform into them.

groups.name: Hyperkinesis
groups.desc: Always-on heightened senses and awareness.

groups.name: Dragon Physiology
groups.desc: A pure dragon body: monstrous strength, scale durability and fast regeneration.

groups.name: Prismorph
groups.desc: Real-time adaptive shapeshifting from demon and dragon blood. Speed over force.

groups.name: Vampiric Shapeshifting
groups.desc: Partial transformations of hands, eyes and fangs. Eye color shows his state.

groups.name: Partial Beast Manifestation
groups.desc: An early awakening side effect, before the suit stabilized his power.

groups.name: Acidic Poison Manipulation
groups.desc: Generate, shape and control acidic poison in several states. Calculated and intentional.

groups.name: Winged Flight
groups.desc: Natural biological wings. The only winged character in the SCU.

groups.name: Snake Venoms
groups.desc: The snake houses’ venom families.

groups.name: Hemokinesis
groups.desc: Complete control of blood as fuel, weapon, armor and memory. More lethal than wind, less absolute than Aether.

groups.name: Sanguine Shift
groups.desc: Teleportation through his own blood anchors; he breaks down into blood and reforms. Zaan’s version was more like fleeing through blood.

groups.name: Abyssal Blood Dominion
groups.desc: Living, hungry blood that corrupts everything it touches. It overwhelms instead of calculating.

groups.name: Blood Magic
groups.desc: Blood fuels spells and boosts output, and can bind and extend life. Only partly revealed; the user refuses to use it.

groups.name: Blood Resonance Assimilation
groups.desc: Her vampirism keeps echoes of the gifts of people she bonds with, and preserves memory instead of eroding it.

groups.name: Blood Regeneration
groups.desc: Regeneration through blood and revival through science.

groups.name: Vampirism
groups.desc: The Paleborn curse: strength, speed, regeneration and predator senses.

groups.name: Aldercrest Core Magic
groups.desc: The learned foundation: four magics that come instinctively.

groups.name: Aldercrest Precision Magic
groups.desc: Precision and control disciplines.

groups.name: Aldercrest Signature Spells
groups.desc: Named signature spells.

groups.name: Witch Arts
groups.desc: Witch magic. Iqaris was one of the few demons to master it.

groups.name: Contract Binding
groups.desc: Deals that bind. He never lies; he chooses which truths to tell.

groups.name: Black Magic
groups.desc: The Old Order’s pacts and sacrifice. Not the same as darkness.

groups.name: Omni-Ergon
groups.desc: Total energy command: absorb, store, convert and release any energy. He survives energy; he does not rule it.

groups.name: Raven Arts
groups.desc: Ravenblade’s core assassination skills: perfect timing and movement, no superpowers.

groups.name: Hidden Ones Training
groups.desc: Skills gained from the Hidden Ones and Arashi’s refinement.

groups.name: Long Shadow
groups.desc: DEW-trained long-range killing, with Shadow Step learned from Ravenblade.

groups.name: Combat Cognition
groups.desc: A maxed-out human mind in a fight.

groups.name: Martial Mastery
groups.desc: A mixed fighting system with an unbreakable mindset.

groups.name: Environmental Weaponization
groups.desc: Turn anything into a weapon.

groups.name: Softcore Armament
groups.desc: His tie: soft and harmless-looking until it hardens beyond any known metal.

groups.name: Vanguard Doctrine
groups.desc: Derek’s brute-force soldier style: a peak-human with a heavy pistol.

groups.name: Blind Blade
groups.desc: Arashi’s swordsmanship: he fights without sight and keeps improving. His sword philosophy shaped Valeria.

groups.name: Weapon Mastery
groups.desc: Yoshiko chooses her weapon by mission.

groups.name: Shadow Blade Arts
groups.desc: Yoshiko’s signature moves that need no power.

groups.name: Fate Draw
groups.desc: Saya’s close-range sword execution with Kara Yazgı: no flourish, one decisive cut.

groups.name: Shishōjutsu
groups.desc: Controlled, precision corpse manipulation: an ofuda amulet on the corpse and one with the user, activated together. The magic lives in the talisman, so she stays human.

groups.name: Kara Curse-Binding
groups.desc: The Kara bloodline’s art of sealing curses into weapons and objects.

groups.name: Ichor Program
groups.desc: DEW’s enhancement serums. A-IV is Victor’s formula mixed with Aethel blood; Ichor adds Alt David’s technology and needs exceptional minds.

groups.name: Anthony Chip
groups.desc: The chip that gave Derek his peak and his moral fracture.

groups.name: Ayaan’s Suit
groups.desc: A tech hero’s armor: it makes him functional under fear.

Killed him twice; voided by him
